items.title: Define read-only reviewer command boundary
items.context: Clarify which Koala commands are blocked when a delegated reviewer is explicitly in read-only mode, and preserve normal reviewer write mode.
items.userSees: User opens role-separation.md and sees: "Advisory external reviewers must run with KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1; their text is advice, not gate evidence."

happy.desc: Docs define KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 as an advisory/delegated reviewer mode that permits only read-only Koala inspection commands.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish advisory read-only reviewers from normal Koala reviewers that must write signed reviewer evidence.

adversarial.desc: Docs explicitly say read-only reviewer summaries cannot satisfy gate evidence and the owner must record authoritative evidence after advisory review.

items.title: Implement mechanical readonly command guard
items.context: Add CLI/command-policy enforcement keyed by an explicit readonly reviewer environment/config flag, rejecting review_pass_set/finding_add/story_advance and other mutating commands before handler writes.
items.userSees: User runs `KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 koala review_pass_set --storyId=B-xxxx ...` and sees: "KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 blocks review_pass_set because it is reviewerWrite; read-only reviewers may only run read-only Koala commands."

happy.desc: With KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1, an effective readOnly command such as session_brief/story_get/checklist_get is allowed.

edge.desc: With KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1, reviewerWrite commands such as review_pass_set/finding_add/review_run_start/init_check_set are blocked before handler writes.

adversarial.desc: With KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1, storyScoped/mainShared/dangerous commands such as story_advance --forceTakeover, verification_evidence_add, and audit/gap writes cannot bypass the guard.

items.title: Add regression coverage for blocked and allowed paths
items.context: Test that readonly reviewer mode blocks mutating commands without writing artifacts, while read-only commands and normal reviewer write mode still work.
items.userSees: Test output contains: "reviewer-readonly command policy smoke passed" and "normal reviewerWrite remains allowed without KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY".

happy.desc: Focused smoke output proves KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 blocks a mutating reviewer command and writes no review-pass artifact.

edge.desc: Focused or contract coverage proves no-env normal reviewerWrite behavior remains allowed.

adversarial.desc: Coverage includes an attempted takeover/dangerous or story-scoped mutation under readonly mode and verifies it is rejected before owner-lease flow.

items.title: Update reviewer dispatch guidance
items.context: Update docs/prompts or adapter guidance so owner agents launching read-only external reviewers set the new readonly mode and collect structured JSON themselves.
items.userSees: Owner guidance says: "For advisory Claude/Codex/Gemini reviews, set KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 on that spawned process only; normal Koala reviewers must not set it."

happy.desc: Owner/agent guidance tells advisory external reviewers to run with KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 and return structured review JSON/text to the owner.

edge.desc: Guidance preserves normal Koala gate reviewers: they should not set readonly mode because they must call review_run_start/finding_add/review_pass_set.

adversarial.desc: Guidance warns that if the env was omitted, the owner must treat the review as non-sandboxed and verify/record evidence explicitly rather than trusting reviewer self-pass text.

items.title: Validate lifecycle and evidence
items.context: Run build, focused smoke tests, process-fact contract, koala validate/session_brief, reviewer pass, delivery check, and summary before DONE.
items.userSees: Final transcript shows: "build PASS; reviewer-readonly smoke PASS; command ownership contract PASS; koala validate PASS; DONE gate PASS."

happy.desc: Build, focused readonly smoke, command ownership contract, process/runtime fact contracts, validate, and session_brief pass.

edge.desc: REVIEW evidence is current after implementation commits and includes standard reviewer pass/finding artifacts, not advisory read-only text alone.

adversarial.desc: DONE gate cannot pass if readonly reviewer docs/prompts drift, if evidence is stale, or if delivery/summary artifacts are missing.
